intro: The Witherbark trolls do not have Sharpbeak, so Gryphon Master Talonaxe wonders whether the Vilebranch trolls took the young gryphon instead. You are sent to the Altar of Zul, at the western edge of Vilebranch lands, to search for him.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Sharpbeak was not with the Witherbark trolls. Perhaps the Vilebranch trolls took him. Go to the Altar of Zul on the western edge of Vilebranch territory and search for the gryphon child.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hurry, friend! If the Vilebranch trolls have Sharpbeak, then who knows what they might be doing with him!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Sharpbeak wasn't there? That is bad news, but it is good news too...
It is good that he was not at the Altar of Zul for the Vilebranch trolls are known for performing sacrifices.
I thank you for all of your aid, but I'm afraid I have an even greater task ahead.
